result.title: Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On
result.comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, Sydney. 20 pages, 5 figures
result.summary: A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels. We exploit an accident of an industrial deployment in which the same ~53k prompts were labelled twice, under two operational definitions ("is this a request for harmful content?" and "would a moderator block this?"), and used to train ten guardrail arms sharing architecture, codebase and optimiser family, at two model scales. First, the guardrail's own training corpus already contained the benchmarks: JailbreakBench-benign is 88% and OR-Bench-hard 82% present in the training pools, two over-refusal benchmarks, the kind a guardrail reports to argue it does not over-block. Everything below is decontaminated. Second, safety benchmarks stratify sharply by how much of their score is decided by the label definition rather than by the model: with architecture and optimiser fixed, the range across the ten arms is 0.99 on HarmBench-copyright and 0.043 on WildGuard-benign, a 23x spread. Third, a benchmark score can be moved across its entire range by 0.03% of the parameters. Across these arms HarmBench-copyright spans 0-100 and OR-Bench-hard over-refusal 3.4-56.4%, and the four arms whose last supervision signal carries a given policy occupy one extreme of both (exact rank p=0.005, or 0.04-0.14 at worst), at unchanged detection capability. For a distilled student the teacher's soft labels do this even when every hard label carries the other policy, so teacher provenance is an unrecorded confound in any released checkpoint. Fourth, validation accuracy on the one split that grades all twenty arms tracks agreement with the annotator's policy (rho=+0.74), not detection capability (rho=+0.34). We argue that guardrail evaluations should report contamination, a seed floor and the definition they were graded against as first-class variables.

AI.brief_summary: 论文利用同一批约 5.3 万提示被两种操作定义重复标注的工业部署，训练十个共享架构与优化器的 guardrail 模型，发现安全基准分数在固定架构下可相差 23 倍、且验证准确率追踪的是与标注者「安全定义」的一致而非检测能力，训练语料本身已含基准污染，因此主张评估需报告污染、种子下限与所用定义。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文关于「基准衡量的是标签定义而非能力」及教师软标签可偷渡另一套政策（蒸馏来源成为未记录混淆）的发现，可能为 LVR/VLM 推理评测中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益究竟来自能力还是监督与标注约定提供核查视角，但属跨领域类比，需自行判断可迁移性。
